title: Verdict
description: A POINTER, never prose intended for posting. The classifier sorts one signal into the beacon's buckets and scores its topical fit.

bucket.description: The single best-matching bucket name from the beacon's bucket list, or "noise" if none fit.

scores.description: Per-bucket confidence, keyed by bucket name, each 0..1.

fit.description: Topical relevance to the beacon's context, 0..1. Drives delivery thresholds.

summary.description: One line describing what the signal is, for the embed only. Never a drafted reply.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences of glass-box justification for the bucket and fit.
